messages:
maya: customer flagged double billing after stream resume + tool fallback. logs show session_marker advanced after truncation and then fallback confirmed same tokens. any ideas?

sam: can you paste the smallest repro logs? should help isolate whether it's routing or ledger dup.

maya: here's snippet from proxy logs:
```
[2026-03-22T14:12:03Z] session_id=abc123 marker=42 route=canary -> handoff
[2026-03-22T14:12:04Z] stream truncated at client side, client reconnect
[2026-03-22T14:12:05Z] new request session_id=abc123 marker=45 routed fallback
[2026-03-22T14:12:06Z] toolcall invoked -> confirmed tokens apply
[2026-03-22T14:12:07Z] ledger: provisional +45, confirmed +45
```

sam: aha. looks like the provisional credit from route A wasn't reconciled before fallback confirmed. router increments marker on reconnect and handoff path doesn't clear provisional flag.

devops-bot: Incident INC-2412 created: token-ledger-provisional-double-charge

lee: root cause hypothesis: session_marker is local to the initial router hop. when a reconnect happens it emits a new marker but doesn't include provenance of provisional credits. handoff service treats absence of provenance as fresh and credits again.

taylor: UX ask: console should clearly surface 'provisional' versus 'confirmed' token rows in the call timeline + hover explanation. customers are confused why tokens show twice.

alex: telemetry proposal: add fields on token events: marker_origin, provisional=true/false, confirmed_at. sample event payload:
```
{ "session_id": "abc123", "sequence_marker": 45, "marker_origin": "router-canary-2", "provisional": true, "confirmed_at": null }
```

sam: implementation debate: do we change internal API to include sequence_marker header (X-Sequence-Marker) on all handoff requests or augment the event envelope? headers are simpler for hop-by-hop routing.

maya: short-term mitigation: server-side dedupe: if ledger sees a provisional credit for session_id+marker within grace window (<30s), drop duplicate confirm. low-risk and reversible.

lee: concern: that could block legitimate resumed sessions where marker legitimately advances after truncation; maybe only apply dedupe when request has toolcall=true or when route changed.

taylor: for console: add feature flag show_provisional_tokens, with a tooltip and opt-out for enterprise customers. will mock in Figma by EOD.

alex: I'll add telemetry fields and a small migration plan for the events schema. can hook a canary to ingestion pipeline to validate no perf regression.

sam: action items: alex -> telemetry schema + canary (ETA 2d); maya -> server dedupe patch PR (ETA 1d); taylor -> console mock + UX text (ETA EOD); lee -> run synthetic on canary routing + validate with customer repro (ETA 2d).

devops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2026-03-23T03:00:00Z (canary: 10% traffic)

maya: thanks team - looping in @support to update the customer with temporary mitigation.

support: noted, will update customer and request logs. thanks.
